resources.string: No server set: speed test off
How often NetLogger records one row of radio, GPS and battery values. Applies to the next session; a running session keeps its interval.
Finest detail and more battery use. Android may answer with cached cell data, so some rows repeat the previous values.
Fine enough for drive tests at city speeds, with moderate battery use.
Walks and long static tests; half the rows of 1 s.
Very long sessions with the lowest battery use; too coarse to follow handovers while driving.
Preselected on the Live screen; you can still change it there before you press Start. Stored with each session to tell tests apart.
Whatever you used the last time.
In a car or on a motorbike; speed and handovers matter.
On foot, e.g. around a campus or between indoors and outdoors.
The phone stays at one spot, e.g. a speed test or a long measurement at a fixed place.
Inside a building; GPS may be weak or missing.
NetLogger logs the SIM that carries mobile data when you press Start and stays on it for the whole session. To log another SIM, make it the data SIM in Android\'s SIM settings before you start.
